The public package must either exclude the connector and be limited to the core toolkit only, or written customer consent must be obtained. Finding to be recorded on the release ticket.

3. **Export-control (Owen):** Covered encryption functionality requires a SNAP-R self-classification filing before public release. Owen will initiate the filing with the export-classification team and document the classification on the release ticket.

4. **Privacy (Sofia):** 312 pseudonymized customer records in the sample training package must be removed and the removal documented. Sofia will work with engineering to strip these records and update the ticket.

All four checklist items remain blocked. I will not grant final legal approval until every finding is formally recorded on the release ticket and the corresponding remediation is completed and verified. Please proceed with your remediation work and keep the group updated on progress. If any of you encounter additional issues during remediation, flag them immediately.
